findings.summary: Only the first ipam.config entry of the stack network is checked, in the test and in the CI step, so a second pool entry would go unchecked. Taken into #271, whose branch checks every entry and whose proposed CI step requires exactly one.

The cross-check with terraform/README.md passes when the first line containing 'The forwarded address' names the gateway in backticks; a reworded or removed paragraph gives the same message as a wrong address. The read-only coupling to a Terraform-lane file is accepted.
The README sentence about the pinned gateway is one long parenthetical inside the Ports bullet of the Compose stack section.

A second stack on the same server would need its own value for the 10.231.77 literals, GATEWAY in the test, the CI step's network name and the README sentence. Filed as #271 at the maintainer's request.

Pull request #264 was merged three minutes before the human's protected CI commit was pushed to its branch, so main pinned the gateway without checking it in CI until pull request #273 carried the commit. Nothing checked that the human-task commit was on the branch before the merge; the task file's push step and the merge are separate human steps.
